parameters.query: SELECT ec.id AS candidate_id, ec.company_id, ec.company_name, ec.person_name, ec.title, ec.action, ec.source_title, ec.pub_date FROM executive_candidates ec WHERE ec.status = 'approved' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM executive_profiles ep WHERE ep.company_id = ec.company_id AND ep.person_name = ec.person_name AND ep.title = ec.title)

=INSERT INTO executive_profiles (company_id, company_name, person_name, title, action, linkedin_url, linkedin_snippet, source_title, pub_date) VALUES ('{{ $json.company_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $json.company_name }}', '{{ $json.person_name }}', '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.action }}', '{{ $json.linkedin_url || '' }}', '{{ ($json.linkedin_snippet || '').substring(0, 500) }}', '{{ $json.source_title }}', '{{ $json.pub_date }}') ON CONFLICT (company_id, person_name, title) DO UPDATE SET action = EXCLUDED.action, linkedin_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linkedin_url, executive_profiles.linkedin_url), linkedin_snippet = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linkedin_snippet, executive_profiles.linkedin_snippet), detected_at = now()

=INSERT INTO signals (company_id, company_name, signal_type, signal_title, signal_url, signal_date, signal_category, raw_summary) VALUES ('{{ $json.company_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $json.company_name }}', 'executive', '{{ $json.person_name }} - {{ $json.title }} ({{ $json.action }})', '{{ $json.linkedin_url || '' }}', current_date, 'leadership', '{{ $json.source_title }}') ON CONFLICT (company_id, signal_type, signal_title, signal_date) DO NOTHING

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Executive enrich completed' }) }}
